recognize_zh: 數顆大型細胞具偏位圓核、粗塊狀（鐘面樣）染色質，以及豐富深藍色帶小空泡的胞質，在血液背景中成群出現，符合循環中的漿細胞（漿細胞白血病）。
features: Several large plasma cells with abundant deep blue cytoplasm and eccentric round nuclei
Coarsely clumped, clock-face-like chromatin; small nucleoli in some cells
Fine cytoplasmic vacuoles; perinuclear hof only subtle
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and a small degenerated granulocyte for size comparison
Red cell background without striking rouleaux in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of large circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. A monocyte and a degenerating granulocyte are present nearby. The plasma cells are larger than typical mature plasma cells, suggesting some immaturity. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are fewer, smaller, and polytypic for kappa and lambda light chains.
LPL shows mainly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with CD19/CD20 expression and MYD88 L265P rather than sheets of CD138-positive plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma cells have larger nuclei with prominent central nucleoli and very high proliferation, usually presenting as an extramedullary mass, often EBV-positive.
